title: Annen tok mu?

characters.MOTHER: a mother in her thirties with dark brown hair in a low bun, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a long green dress
characters.BOY: her son, a boy of about seven with short black hair, wearing a red striped sweater
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty with short black hair and a light beard, wearing a red sweater
characters.OLDMOM: the same mother, now in her sixties with grey hair in a low bun, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan

scenes.text:
Annen "Ben tokum" dediğinde,
aslında hiç tok değildi.
scenes.prompt: In a small warm kitchen on a rainy autumn evening, {MOTHER} sits at a wooden table with an empty plate in front of her, smiling softly at {BOY} who sits across from her. Rain on the window, a warm lamp above the table.

scenes.text:
Son dilim hep sessizce
senin tabağına geçerdi.
scenes.prompt: {BOY} sits at the kitchen table with a big slice of apple pie on a plate in front of him, eyes wide with joy, while {MOTHER} stands beside the table smiling at him. Warm lamp light, rain on the window.
{MOTHER} stands by the kitchen window with a calm gentle smile, an empty plate on the counter beside her, {BOY} looks up at her curiously. Autumn leaves blowing outside, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Meğer seni doyurmak,
onu herkesten çok doyururmuş.
scenes.prompt: Years later in the same warm kitchen, {OLDMOM} stands by the table watching {MAN}, who sits with a full plate of food in front of him, her face glowing with quiet happiness. Rain on the window, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Bu akşam son dilimi sen ona bırak.
Bunu annene gönder.
scenes.prompt: {OLDMOM} sits at the kitchen table with a slice of apple pie on a plate in front of her, laughing, while {MAN} sits beside her smiling. A warm lamp and a glowing candle, autumn leaves falling outside the window.

caption:
Annen gerçekten tok mu?

O hep son dilimi sana bıraktı. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder.
